product_family: Commercial real estate data platform providing property intelligence, owner records, transaction history, and market data across 53M+ US properties via web app and API solutions

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 1
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence Reonomy holds SOC 2. Reonomy's Master Subscription Agreement and Privacy Policy contain no mention of SOC 2. Parent company Altus's trust center (trust.altus.pro) does not name Reonomy and shows Altus only 'working towards SOC Type 2' (not yet certified).

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 2
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence Reonomy holds SOC 2. Reonomy's Master Subscription Agreement and Privacy Policy contain no mention of SOC 2, and parent Altus's trust center shows Altus only 'working towards SOC Type 2' without naming Reonomy. MSA disclaims security: 'Reonomy does not warrant that the Reonomy Services are completely free from all bugs, errors, or omissions, or will ensure complete security.'

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence Reonomy holds ISO 27001. Reonomy does not claim ISO 27001 in its legal documents. Parent company Altus's trust center (trust.altus.pro) shows Altus holds ISO/IEC 27001:2022, but Reonomy is not named or scoped there and a parent certification does not extend to the Reonomy service.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. Privacy Policy makes no mention of HIPAA compliance. Not applicable to commercial real estate data platform use case.

certifications.name: GDPR Compliance
certifications.proof_quote: Privacy Policy contains no mention of GDPR compliance, DPA, or EU data protection obligations. Data processing statement: 'Your information...may be stored and processed in the United States or any other country' with no specific regional restrictions or GDPR safeguards noted.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. Not claimed in legal documents.

certifications.name: ISO 27017 (Cloud Security)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. Not claimed in legal documents or trust center.

certifications.name: ISO 27018 (Cloud PII Protection)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. Not claimed in legal documents.

certifications.name: ISO 42001 (AI Management)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. Not claimed. Reonomy uses machine learning and AI models via Databricks but does not claim AI governance certifications.

privacy.ai_training_note: Privacy Policy states Reonomy may 'aggregate and de-identify Customer Data' and 'collect and use Usage Data'. Master Subscription Agreement explicitly incorporates DPA for Personal Data processing. However, no explicit statement on whether de-identified customer data is used for AI model training. Company uses Databricks for ML model development, but training data sources are not publicly documented.

security.name: Encryption in Transit
security.value: SSL/TLS implemented and current (no major CVE vulnerabilities per UpGuard assessment)

security.name: Secure Cookies
security.value: NOT IMPLEMENTED - UpGuard report notes 'Secure cookies not used', increasing interception risk

security.name: HttpOnly Cookie Protection
security.value: NOT IMPLEMENTED - UpGuard report notes 'HttpOnly cookies not used', enabling client-side attacks

security.name: Content Security Policy
security.value: MISCONFIGURED - 'CSP allows insecure active sources' and 'CSP implemented unsafely'

security.name: MIME Sniffing Protection
security.value: NOT IMPLEMENTED - 'X-Content-Type-Options is not nosniff', enabling MIME confusion attacks

security.name: HSTS Implementation
security.value: Partial - HSTS header present but 'not on preload list' and lacks 'includeSubDomains' directive

security.name: Email Security (DMARC)
security.value: WEAK - 'DMARC policy is p=none', providing no anti-fraud/spoofing protection

security.name: Email Security (SPF)
security.value: LENIENT - SPF uses '~all' mechanism (soft fail), allowing unauthorized senders to send mail from domain

security.name: Malware & Botnet Status
security.value: No malware, phishing, or botnet activity detected

flags: Reonomy has no public trust center or security certifications page.
No SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, or other standard security certifications are claimed or verified.

Reonomy's website received a B grade from UpGuard (732/950) due to multiple security misconfigurations: missing secure/HttpOnly cookies, unsafe CSP, no MIME sniffing protection, weak HSTS, and weak DMARC/SPF policies.

The Privacy Policy references California (CCPA) consumer rights through a separate Location-Based Rights Notice; the service is US-operated and intended for US users. There are no public metrics on how requests are handled.
The Privacy Policy allows data storage in 'any other country' with no specific safeguards, raising concerns for EU customers and GDPR applicability.
While the MSA references a DPA for Personal Data, no public Data Processing Agreement is published on the vendor website.

The Privacy Policy mentions 'aggregate and de-identify' customer data and the company uses Databricks for ML, but there is no explicit statement on whether customer data (de-identified or not) is used for model training.
Parent company Altus Group holds ISO 27001, but Reonomy is not listed in their trust center as having certifications. Parent company certifications do not automatically apply to a subsidiary.
The Master Subscription Agreement explicitly disclaims security: 'does not warrant...will ensure complete security'.
The MSA caps liability at the greater of $1,000 or the amount paid in the preceding 12 months, limiting recourse for data breaches or compliance violations.
